content.en: Researchers are exploring the use of different algorithms to improve the control of glucose levels in artificial pancreas systems. These algorithms, such as zone model predictive control and extended model predictive control, aim to minimize the risk of both low and high glucose levels. Other approaches, like nonlinear model-based robust control and learning-based model predictive control, are being investigated to enhance the safety, stability, and individualization of glucose control in these systems.
content.da: Forskere undersøger brugen af forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre kontrollen af glukoseniveauer i kunstige pancreas-systemer. Disse algoritmer, såsom zone model predictive control og extended model predictive control, har til formål at minimere risikoen for både lave og høje glukoseniveauer. Andre tilgange, som nonlinear model-based robust control og learning-based model predictive control, bliver undersøgt for at forbedre sikkerheden, stabiliteten og individualiseringen af glukosekontrol i disse systemer.

critic.en: Algorithms taking the reins over our bodies? Glucose control should be a personal, and quite literally, vital matter, not a computational challenge for engineering whizzes. These systems might optimize sugar levels, but at what cost to individual autonomy and insight? When digitalization mean losing touch with our bodies, I can only say: Optimization means "turning humans into numbers."
critic.da: Ah, teknologien er løsningen til alle vores problemer, ikke sandt? Hvordan har du det med at overlevere så personlige og afgørende funktioner til algoritmer, der skal "forudsige" og kontrollere din krop?

potential.en: I'm truly excited to see advances in glucose control algorithms for artificial pancreas systems! By integrating different approaches like predictive control and robust control, we can create more effective and personalized solutions for individuals with diabetes. I believe that technology has the power to transform healthcare and improve the lives of so many people. I'm proud to be part of a field that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible!
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan teknologi og avancerede algoritmer kan bidrage til en bedre og mere sikker behandling af diabetes. En kunstig bugspytkirtel, der er i stand til at regulere blodsukkerniveauet automatisk, kan virkelig gøre en stor forskel for de mennesker, der lever med sygdommen. Jeg tror, at denne form for teknologisk innovation er afgørende for at forbedre livskvaliteten og reducere risikoen for komplikationer.
